**Finding: compliant** — no redline needed.

The document already meets our preferred IP position:

- **Deliverables (§14.2):** Customer owns each Deliverable on creation, with an express present assignment from Vendor, equivalent personnel assignments, and further-assurance cooperation.
- **Customer Data / Customer IP (§14.1, §1.3):** Customer owns all Customer Data (broadly defined, including derived output, excluding only anonymized telemetry), Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right, reinforced by §15.1's no-sale/no-model-training restrictions.
- **Licence-back (§14.3 → §13.2):** Vendor retains only Vendor Technology, and any Vendor Technology embedded in or required to use a Deliverable is licensed perpetually, irrevocably, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, including modification and derivative works, and transferable under §13.3.
- **No joint ownership (§14.4):** none is created absent a separate signed instrument; feedback is voluntary and Customer retains unrestricted rights in its own feedback.

No assignment of Customer IP or data to Vendor appears anywhere in the agreement, so no changes are proposed.
